IF
MovedFromTo(S_UND_CallarduranTrinket_82261770-46e3-403c-8ab0-b6cdb185d29a, _, _PartyMember, 0)
AND
DB_PartyMembers((CHARACTER)_PartyMember)
AND
NOT DB_Defeated(S_UND_CorpseDisposer_Leader_5df19256-efcc-44c5-8fba-0add58492ccf)
AND
NOT DB_Defeated(S_UND_CorpseDisposer_000_e63c75ba-8e0a-4292-a04a-a5d4c8a2816c)
THEN
PROC_GLO_Backgrounds_CompleteGoal((CHARACTER)_PartyMember, "Act1_Urchin_DeadGnomeTrinket");

IF
ItemEnteredTrigger(S_GOB_WolfPens_CageDoor_002_19b032a0-e027-4524-96f9-1c0cd48d726e, S_GOB_WolfPens_SplatteringTrigger_80390dec-caa3-4e6b-b2bc-632525d95dee, _)
AND
DB_GLO_DefeatCounter(_Character, "GOB_WolfPens_DefeatCounter")
AND
_Character != S_GOB_WolfPens_Parent_6e4dd891-7bfe-4656-a9a0-ecf0916fd8f0
AND
IsInTrigger(_Character, S_GOB_WolfPens_DoorDamageTrigger_35e21ace-d889-4239-a8bc-e1b12ea33b80, 1)
AND
Random(10, _Rand)
AND
IntegerProduct(_Rand, 3, _Damage)
THEN
ApplyDamage(_Character, _Damage, "Bludgeoning", S_GOB_WolfPens_CageDoor_002_19b032a0-e027-4524-96f9-1c0cd48d726e);

IF
DB_Defeated(S_SCL_HarperScout_000_c6dfb2aa-809f-4b3e-8b32-968c10184ec3)
AND
DB_Defeated(S_SCL_HarperScout_001_25e154f6-d762-4bea-862e-98c48d7ebe3e)
AND
NOT DB_Is_InCombat(S_SCL_HarperScout_003_9bebec18-ca66-42e9-abce-8d6a5f9d2a1b, _)
AND
NOT DB_SCL_ShadowCurse_InSafeZone(S_SCL_HarperScout_003_9bebec18-ca66-42e9-abce-8d6a5f9d2a1b)
AND
NOT DB_CantAct(S_SCL_HarperScout_003_9bebec18-ca66-42e9-abce-8d6a5f9d2a1b)
AND
NOT DB_SCL_HarperScouts_KarrowWithTorchEquipped(1)
AND
IsInInventoryOf((ITEM)S_SCL_HarperScout_003_Torch_e991cf68-de7c-4466-9170-c95e97a3dc10, S_SCL_HarperScout_003_9bebec18-ca66-42e9-abce-8d6a5f9d2a1b, 1)
THEN
Equip((CHARACTER)S_SCL_HarperScout_003_9bebec18-ca66-42e9-abce-8d6a5f9d2a1b, (ITEM)S_SCL_HarperScout_003_Torch_e991cf68-de7c-4466-9170-c95e97a3dc10);

QRY

AND
NOT DB_CustomUseItemResponse(_Player, S_TWN_ActExit_4df293a7-c9b7-4be4-b4a9-42400ddbe209, _)
AND
QRY_SCL_PartyMemberShadowcursed()
THEN
DB_CustomUseItemResponse(_Player, S_TWN_ActExit_4df293a7-c9b7-4be4-b4a9-42400ddbe209, 0);

IF
UseFinished(_Player,S_LOW_GortashFamilyHome_GortashPortrait_5d8c20bc-1e8a-4637-bde2-fc1b5dbdf688,1)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
DB_Is_InCombat(_Player,_)
THEN
PROC_PlayCantUseItemAD(_Player);
